$comment: Source registry for lectionary citations (docs/decisions/011-lectionary-source.md). Every `source` in calendar/lectionary/<block>/*.json is `<id>[@<revision>] <locator>`; the id must be listed here and the locator must match its locatorPattern. Checked by `npm run lectionary:check`.

litcal.title: Liturgical Calendar API lectionary corpus
litcal.translation: US Lectionary for Mass citation strings (NABRE)
litcal.notes: Locators are relative to jsondata/sourcedata/rite/roman/lectionary/ (or jsondata/sourcedata/rite/roman/ for decrees/…). Imported with packages/lectionary/src/cli/import-litcal.ts.

olm-1981.title: Ordo Lectionum Missae, editio typica altera
olm-1981.bibliography: Ordo Lectionum Missae, editio typica altera. Città del Vaticano: Libreria Editrice Vaticana, 1981
olm-1981.physicalCopy: none yet; purchase of a print copy is open question Q4 in 011
olm-1981.notes: `p<page>#<OLM lectionary number>`. `p?` marks a citation whose page is not recorded yet; the verifier fills it in from a print copy.

ddw-decree.title: Decrees of the Dicastery for Divine Worship adding or changing readings
ddw-decree.bibliography: Congregation / Dicastery for Divine Worship and the Discipline of the Sacraments, decrees (Prot. N. as cited)

ke-lect-2020.title: Lectionary (Kenya), chapel edition
ke-lect-2020.bibliography: Lectionary, chapel edition, 3 vols. Nairobi: Paulines Publications Africa, 2020. ISBN 9966-60-148-3
ke-lect-2020.translation: RSV-2CE readings, Grail-family psalter (to confirm, Q1)
ke-lect-2020.licence: © Paulines Publications Africa and translation owners; citations only (facts)
ke-lect-2020.physicalCopy: to be named by the owner (Q1)
ke-lect-2020.notes: The verification source: a verifier sets status to verified and records this locator.
